summary: Frontend-only testing of drill-category highlights, labels, blddb deep-linking and hint auto-close-on-solve. 6 of 7 spec items pass. The 'hint auto-close on manual Space / trainer-main tap' scenario FAILS because the global keyboard handler and screen-tap handler early-return when hintOpen is true, so validate() is never invoked and onSuccess (which contains setHintOpen(false)) never runs. Auto-close DOES work when the case is solved via real cube state change (onStateChanged path), because that path bypasses the guards.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Space or tapping trainer-main while the Hint modal is open does NOT validate the case and does NOT close the Hint modal. Guard `if (drawer || hintOpen || subsetOpen || macPrompt) return;` at lines 369 and 423 blocks validate()/handleScreenTap while hintOpen=true. Consequence: setHintOpen(false) inside onSuccess (line 234) is never reached for a manual solve. Only Bluetooth cube state change (window.__trainer.solveCurrent / onStateChanged) actually auto-closes the hint. Repro: click hint-btn → press Space (or click trainer-main) → modal stays open, hud-solved does NOT increment.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/App.js remove `hintOpen` from the guard on line 369 (handleScreenTap) and line 423 (keyboard handler) — OR add a dedicated branch that, when hintOpen is true, still routes Space / a tap on trainer-main through validate(). onSuccess already closes the hint via setHintOpen(false), so allowing validate() to run is all that's needed. Ensure other keys (letter moves, 'h', Escape) remain gated appropriately.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1702 lines — well over the 700-line threshold; split into hooks/components (trainer state, keyboard handler, category loader, HintModal etc).
handleScreenTap and the keydown handler duplicate the same drawer/hintOpen/subsetOpen/macPrompt guard; extract to a `isInputBlocked()` helper.

The hint 'Loading algorithms from v2.blddb.net…' state leaves hint-blddb-link href as the bare base URL (e.g. https://v2.blddb.net/corner without ?position=&mode=). Consider disabling / hiding the anchor until the case URL is computed, otherwise a user clicking early lands on the wrong page.
onSuccess uses setTimeout(60) to rebuild the case; combined with busyRef this is fragile — a Promise-based state machine would be cleaner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All highlight/color/label specs pass: Flips=2G, Twists=2G, LTCT=2G+1B with CD[E] label, Parity=2B+2G with 'BC CD' label, Corners/Edges regression 2G+1B. blddb links are correct once algorithms finish loading (LTCT: /ltct?position=UFR-FLD-BRD&mode=nightmare; Corners: /corner?position=UFR-BLD-BLU&mode=nightmare). Only outstanding bug is manual Space/tap not triggering solve when hint modal is open. Auto-close via onSuccess itself is proven working — verified by calling window.__trainer.solveCurrent() which routes through onStateChanged→onSuccess and closes the modal + increments hud-solved.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug: Hint modal does not close on manual solve. RCA: In /app/frontend/src/App.js, both the global keydown handler (line 422-435) and handleScreenTap (line 368-381) begin with `if (drawer || hintOpen || subsetOpen || macPrompt) return;`. So when the user opens the Hint panel, pressing Space or single-tapping trainer-main is a no-op — validate() is never called, therefore onSuccess and its setHintOpen(false) never run. The autoclose logic itself is correct; the guard needs to allow the validate action while hint is open. Fix: either drop hintOpen from these two guards, or add `if (hintOpen && (e.key === ' ' || ...)) { validate(); setHintOpen(false); return; }` before the early return. Verified working path: solving through cube state change (window.__trainer.solveCurrent) closes the modal and increments Solved counter.
